qfd_tile_nk_a0c.insertion_basis: 12.3 common core latency 250 TT / 202.5 FF kit frame (KIT_PREFLIGHT ff_binding); the die taps the A0 centre entry EARLY by (routed trunk insertion - frame): DIE-QC-17 routed trunk 716/623 TT/FF (nk t5), COORD 14:21
qfd_tile_nk_a0c._why: QC-A0-KITS-6 10-28: A0 PARENT kit (glue + SIGNED hard children). Children views must be SIGNED (export_view layout) at the listed dirs; today none is (generator refuses, all named). Clock = the slice centre entry; the plan trunk (tools/die_plan/parent_trunk_dme.py) is NOT yet wired as the kit CTS hook (insertion_balance off; next step). M7 = parent routes over children (OBS <= M5), as the QC-A0-KITS-3 parent trial.
qfd_tile_nk_a0c._why_icg: QC-A0-KITS-9 10-28: ICG=1 (OWNER option c, QC-PG-5-ICG on main 07f037d9b): one ICGx8DC u_icg at the tile root, RTL enable (go face | ~me_idle | node valid | reset | drain); the clock-gating setup/hold on u_icg ENA is the liberty ICG check (OpenSTA infers it, reported at sign-off). Parent CTS = parent_trunk_dme --ungated-split (face branch + gated branch behind u_icg, ICG_INST reuse) once the kit CTS hook is wired.
